subject: general
question: Which position within the Union Council of Ministers of India is immediately below the Prime Minister in hierarchy?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Cabinet Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Council of Ministers** in India consists of different levels of ministers, including the Prime Minister, **Cabinet Ministers**, Ministers of State, and Deputy Ministers.
 
• A **Cabinet Minister** holds the highest position in the council after the Prime Minister and is responsible for major ministries such as Finance, Defence, Home Affairs, External Affairs, etc.
 
• Cabinet Ministers are part of the **core decision-making body** in the government and attend cabinet meetings chaired by the Prime Minister.
 
• The Cabinet Ministers are responsible for framing policies, implementing laws, and overseeing the functioning of their respective ministries.
 
• The hierarchy within the Union Council of Ministers places the **Cabinet Minister** immediately below the Prime Minister, followed by Ministers of State and Deputy Ministers.
 
• This structure ensures efficient governance and delegation of responsibilities across various levels of the government.
 
• Cabinet Ministers are appointed by the **President of India** on the advice of the Prime Minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Minister of State**__

 __
 
• A **Minister of State** is a junior minister who assists the Cabinet Minister in handling their respective ministry.
 
• They may handle specific responsibilities within the ministry or act as independent ministers for less critical portfolios.
 
• While they attend meetings and contribute to policy discussions, they are not part of the core Cabinet meetings.
 
 
 
• **Deputy Minister**__
 __
 
• **Deputy Ministers** are at a lower rank compared to Ministers of State and mainly assist in administrative and operational tasks.
 
• They do not have independent portfolios and work under the guidance of senior ministers.
 
 
 
• **Parliamentary Secretary**__
 
 
• A **Parliamentary Secretary** is not considered a minister but acts as an aide to a senior minister or Cabinet Minister.
 
• They focus on legislative duties and help coordinate between the ministry and parliament.
